Part II  Nutrition Throughout the Life Cycle
Children’s blood pressure percentile ranges vary by age, gender, and height, and are generally lower 
than adult blood pressure levels. It is important to use specific pediatric blood pressure standards 
when assessing blood pressure in children and adolescents.
